title: Change lifecycle
summary: Assess and deliver a change with proportionate decisions, evidence, and communication.
entryConditions: A change to product behavior, policy, or operation is proposed
steps: State the motivation and affected outcomes
Choose an authorized approach and migration path; update architecture catalogs when decisions change

Plan implementation and criterion-linked verification against coding standards; use the repository end-to-end runner or Playwright for changed browser journeys, frontend-acceptance for visual criteria, and integration tests for changed system boundaries
